intro.subtitle: Zombie Apocalypse: Tum Decide Karo
intro.hook: Apocalypse shuru ho chuka hai. Tum phanse ho ek sunsaan farmhouse mein. Aur ab story SIRF tum decide karoge.
narration: Shaam 6 baje. {location}. Phone dead hai. Road block hai. Aur bahar... bahar kuch bahut galat chal raha hai.
Gate ki taraf se wahi awaazein aa rahi hain jo news mein suni thi. Tum andar ho. Aaj raat tum yahin rahoge.
Ab suno rule: har din tumhe do raste milenge. Tum comment mein 1 ya 2 likhoge. Sabse zyada votes wala rasta jeetega. Koi undo button nahi hai.
Kal raat pehli asli raat hai. Better ho jaao.
images: isolated indian farmhouse at dusk, dirt driveway, dark fields all around, one window lit, ominous
hands boarding up a wooden farmhouse door with planks, dim lantern light, tense
dead smartphone on a wooden table, candle flame nearby, dusk light through window

garage_sound.subtitle: Garage Ki Awaaz
garage_sound.hook: Raat 2 baje farmhouse ke garage se awaaz aayi. Andar gaadi, tools aur kal ka ration hai. Tum kya karoge?
narration: Raat 2 baje. Neend mein tumhe awaaz sunai deti hai. Awaaz tumhare farm ke garage se aa rahi hai. Kuch bhaari gira hai. Phir silence.
Garage mein gaadi hai, tools hain, aur kal ka saara ration. Par us darwaze ke us taraf wala andhera tumne 3 din se khola nahi.
Ab batao: RUN — chupke se peeche ke darwaze se bhaag jao, jaan bachao. Ya CHECK — jaake dekho andar kya hai?
images: dark garage exterior of an indian farmhouse at night, half open metal door, moonlight, fog
flashlight beam cutting through a dark garage interior, dust particles floating, tool rack silhouette
close up of a trembling hand reaching for a wooden door handle, dark, cinematic horror

run_fields.subtitle: Khet Ke Andhere Mein
run_fields.hook: Tum bhaage. Par khet mein kuch khada hai... jo tumhe dekh raha hai.
narration: Tum peeche ke darwaze se nikle. Khet tak bhage. Sans phool rahi hai. Peeche se wahi awaaz aayi. Bhaari. Tedhi.
Aage do cheezein dikh rahi hain: purana borewell ka platform, jiske pipe mein chhup sakte ho. Aur aage tube light ke neeche... koi khada hai.
Chhup jao, ya dekho kaun hai?
images: running through tall dark crops at night, flashlight dropped on ground, motion blur, panic
old concrete tube well platform in a dark field, narrow opening, moonlight
distant human silhouette standing under a flickering tubelight, fog, eerie

pipe_hide.subtitle: Pipe Ke Andar
pipe_hide.hook: Tum pipe mein chhupe. Aur bahar wala saaya... ruk gaya. Usne tumhe dekh liya hai.
narration: Tum pipe mein utar gaye. Dhadkan kaanon mein. Bahar kadam ruke. Kisi ne dhool mein paer ghumaye.
Phir awaaz aayi. Dheemi. Insaani. Kaun hai andar? Main insaan hoon. Raj.
Ye awaaz tumhare dost Raj ki hai. Jo kal shehar ke raste nikla tha. Par kya tum bharosa karoge?
Dheere se upar jhanko.
images: narrow dark well pipe interior looking up at a circle of night sky, claustrophobic
a hand reaching down into a dark opening, moonlight silhouette from above
two human eyes reflected in a flashlight beam at night, fear and caution

figure_meet.subtitle: Wo Kaun Hai?
figure_meet.hook: Flashlight tumhari taraf aa rahi hai. Awaaz dena hai... ya chupke nikal jaana hai?
narration: Woh keh raha hai: Raj hoon, shehar se. Gaadi ne dhoka diya. Teen din se isi khet mein hoon. Flashlight tumhari taraf badh rahi hai.
Bharosa karna hai? Ya abhi bhi time hai, chupke se nikal jaane ka?
Ek galat kadam... aur kuch bhi ho sakta hai.
images: flashlight glow approaching through fog in dark fields, tense, cinematic
two men facing each other at a distance in a dark field, moonlight, wary expressions
footprints in mud beside dark crops at night, horror atmosphere

friend_found.subtitle: Asli Raj, Asli Radio
friend_found.hook: Wo Raj hai. Asli Raj. Aur uske jhole mein pakka chamakta hua ek radio hai.
narration: Wo Raj hai. Kamzor, bhookha, par asli. Usne tumhe khet ke kinare bulaya. Uske jhole se crackling awaaz aa rahi hai.
Kehta hai: roz 4 baje bus depot ke survivors signal bhejte hain. Par humein power chahiye. Farmhouse ke basement mein purana generator aur radio set pada hai.
Wapas farmhouse jaana padega. Garage wale saaye ke paas se guzarna padega. Plan ready hai?
Chalo. Aur is baar chupchaap.
images: two exhausted men sitting in a dark field, one holding a vintage radio transceiver, faint light
vintage radio crackling on a wooden table, flashlight glow, dust in air
dark basement stairs of an indian farmhouse with old generator silhouettes

solo_escape.subtitle: Akelа Rasta
solo_escape.hook: Tum chupke nikle. Khet ke kinare par tractor hai... aur uske paas ek gaadi. Jisme kuch hila.
narration: Tumne chupke se kadam badhaye. Raj ki awaaz peeche dheemi pad gayi. Khet ke kinare par ek tractor khada hai. Aur uske bagal mein chhoti si gaadi.
Chabi nahi hai. Par tool box khula hai. Aur gaadi ke engine ke under kuch hila. Dheere dheere. Bilkul jinda kutta ho.
Gaadi ke andar ek charger aur purana radio rakha hai. Ek chhota kadam sab badal deta hai.
images: tractor and a small car at the edge of a dark field at night, tools scattered, fog
car engine bay close up in darkness, moving silhouette blur, horror
vintage car radio glowing faintly on a dashboard at night

check_garage.subtitle: Garage Ke Andar
check_garage.hook: Tumne darwaza khola. Garage khaali hai... almost. Basement ki seedhi se awaaz aa rahi hai.
narration: Tum darwaze tak gaye. Dheere se khola. Gaadi wahi khadi hai. Farsh par ek dabba gira hai. Bas itna sa shor. Phir seedhi se awaaz aayi. Neeche se.
Ya phir gaadi ka dikki kholo. Usme petrol can, chabi aur purana radio tumne khud rakhha tha.
Neeche utro, ya dikki kholkar plan B banao?
images: opening a farmhouse garage door at night, flashlight, junk scattered inside, car silhouette
dark wooden stairs going down to a basement, cobwebs, faint light from below
car trunk open in a dark garage, fuel can and toolbox inside, flashlight glow

basement_dark.subtitle: Basement Ka Raaz
basement_dark.hook: Basement mein generator zinda hai... aur deewar par kisi ne kuch likha hai.
narration: Neeche andhera tha, par ek purana generator dhak dhak kar raha tha. Bijli zinda hai. Matlab radio chal sakta hai.
Deewar par ungli se likha hai: bus depot, roz 4 baje, aa jao. Zinda log.
Aur tab upar se awaaz aayi. Koi dhoond raha hai. Gaon ki taraf se aawaz tumhara naam le rahi hai?
Kaise? Tumne to kisi ko bataya nahi tha.
images: old diesel generator humming in a dark indian basement, cables, one flickering bulb
handwritten message on a concrete basement wall, chalk, eerie shadows
old ham radio set on a shelf in a basement, dial lit, layers of dust

trunk_keys.subtitle: Chabi Mil Gayi
trunk_keys.hook: Chabi mil gayi. Petrol bhi. Par gaadi start hone se pehle... engine ke andar se awaaz.
narration: Dikki khuli. Petrol can, tool box aur wahi purani chabi. Sab mila. Gaadi ke andar charger bhi hai.
Tumne chabi ghumai. Engine khamosh. Battery dead. Aur petrol sirf do liter. Gaon tak pahunchega. Aage nahi.
Tab radio par awaaz aayi: bus depot. Char baje. Zinda log aa jao.
Do raste. Ek chhota sa petrol. Ek paidal chaudah kilometer.
images: open car trunk at night with fuel can, toolbox and an old key, garage interior
car key turning in ignition, dark dashboard, night, tension
car radio crackling inside a dark car interior, faint green light

truck_problem.subtitle: Petrol Ya Depot
truck_problem.hook: Do liter petrol, ya chaudah kilometer paidal. Ek hi rasta pakad sakte ho.
narration: Decision time. Do liter petrol se tum das kilometer nikal sakte ho. Shayad gaon. Shayad kuch aur.
Ya bus depot. Chaudah kilometer. Char ghante paidal. Par wahan zinda log hain, paani hai, deewar hai.
Petrol gaadi mein daalo, ya depot ke liye nikal pado?
images: fuel can and car keys on a car hood at night, decision moment, cinematic
long empty foggy road at night with distant town lights, india
bus depot gate in darkness with survivor silhouettes on the wall, tense hope

radio_room.subtitle: Radio Ki Awaz
radio_room.hook: Radio set zinda ho gaya. Do jagah se signal aa raha hai. Kisi ek ko chunna hai.
narration: Radio clear hua. Pehli awaaz: bus depot. Paani, deewar, log. Roz char baje.
Doosri frequency dheemi thi: radio tower, ek sau barah meter, transmitter zinda hai. Utha lo, aur pura shehar sun sakta hai.
Depot means log aur safety. Tower means aawaz aur umeed. Kahan jaoge?
images: old ham radio set glowing in a dark room, hands tuning the dial, warm light
high radio tower silhouette against a night sky full of stars, fog at base
bus depot entrance with barrier and faded sign, darkness, cautious silhouettes

truck_ready.subtitle: Raat Ya Subah
truck_ready.hook: Gaadi taiyar hai. Raat ke andhere mein niklo... ya subah ka intezaar karo?
narration: Petrol dala. Battery charger lagaya. Gaadi chalegi, bas ek baar. Raat ki sadak khaali hai. Par andhere mein cheezein bhi active hain.
Subah tak rukо, to dhoop mein sab dikh jata hai. Par tum bhi dikhte ho.
Raat ya subah? Ye tumhari aakhri choice hai is farm se nikalne ki.
images: car headlights in dark foggy village road, india, night, tension
first morning light over an abandoned indian highway, mist, hope
hand on a gear lever of an old car, night, dashboard glow, close up

night_drive.subtitle: ENDING: Raat Ki Sawari
night_drive.hook: Andhere mein gaadi, headlights, aur sadak par chalees log. Ye final run hai.
narration: Tum nikal pade. Headlights sirf bees meter dikhati hain. Horn phir horn. Kuch bhaage. Koi nahi. Aath kilometer.
Depot ke gate apne aap khul gaye. Andar teis zinda log. Tumhari gaadi ki battery se unka pura radio system chala.
Subah unki team ne convoy ke saath tumhe aage bheja. Ek bada safe zone. Tum bach gaye.
Season ek khatam. Ab batao season do kahan? Comment karo: 1 pahad, 2 gaon, 3 shehar.
images: car headlights cutting through dark foggy road, silhouettes scattering, headlights glare
gates of a bus depot at night with warm light and people opening them
convoy of old cars and trucks driving at dawn on an indian highway

dawn_drive.subtitle: ENDING: Subah Ki Roshni
dawn_drive.hook: Subah ki roshni. Sadak saaf. Foolproof? Kuch cheezein roshni mein bhi nahi dikhati.
narration: Subah nikle. Dhoop ne zameen par pade chalees logon ko pathar bana diya. Engine zinda tha. Tum zinda the.
Pandrah kilometer baad ek checkpost. Asli log. Asli gun. Unke saath do raste the: aage convoy, ya wapas.
Tumne aage chuna. Naye shehar ki taraf. Naya chapter.
Season ek khatam. Season do kahan? Comment: 1 pahad, 2 gaon, 3 shehar.

checkpoint barrier on a highway with armed survivors at dawn
convoy of vehicles driving toward a distant city skyline at sunrise

depot_run.subtitle: ENDING: Bus Depot
depot_run.hook: Chaudah kilometer paidal. Char ghante. Aur samne bus depot ki deewar.
narration: Tum paidal nikle. Chhe ghante lage. Depot ke gate par log mile. Chaalees zinda log. Paani. Khaana. Deewar.
Andar aane se pehle ek shart: yahan sab kaam karte hain. Aaj se tum guards ki team mein ho.
Kamzor nahi ho tum. Tum bach gaye.
Season ek khatam. Season do kahan? Comment: 1 pahad, 2 gaon, 3 shehar.

bus depot wall with a gate, survivors keeping watch from the roof, dawn light
community of survivors around a small fire in a depot yard, cautious hope

tower_run.subtitle: ENDING: Awaaz Ki Tower
tower_run.hook: Ek sau barah meter upar. Ek transmitter. Agar ye chala... pura shehar sunega.
narration: Tower tak pahunchne mein poori raat lagi. Seedhiyaan zang lagi thi. Har qadam par awaaz. Par tum chadhte gaye.
Transmitter room mein bijli ka ek chhota sa jhatka... aur red light blink karne lagi. Signal live. Pura shehar tumhari awaaz sun raha hai.
Subah tak teen gaadiyaan tower ke base par aa chuki thi. Log aa rahe hain. Tumne apna safe zone khud banaya.
Season ek khatam. Season do kahan? Comment: 1 pahad, 2 gaon, 3 shehar.
